techniques.name: Type as image
techniques.description: Display type at extreme scale — typography IS the visual anchor, not a label above an illustration
motionHints: Tracking or weight shift on load

techniques.name: Generative geometry
techniques.description: Visual built from math/SVG/canvas — rings, segments, fields — not stock illustrations

techniques.name: Editorial asymmetry
techniques.description: Corners, offsets, overlap — magazine layout energy, not bootstrap center stack

techniques.name: Cinematic hero asset
techniques.description: Photo-grade or detailed illustrated scene sets mood — type interacts with the scene
stealList: Copy is poetic or sharp — not buzzwords

techniques.name: Scroll choreography
techniques.description: Hero hands off to page via ScrollTrigger — not a static poster above the fold
stealList: Entrance on load + scroll-linked act two

techniques.name: Interactive surface
techniques.description: Pointer, drag, or game input changes the visual — product feels alive

techniques.name: Illustration narrative
techniques.description: Custom character or scene tells the story — cohesive palette, not clipart

techniques.name: Functional play
techniques.description: Playable moment — puzzle, tilt, drag — engagement without decoration

techniques.name: Editorial lists
techniques.description: Experience / artifacts / experiments as clean rows — title left, meta right, generous vertical rhythm
stealList: Fade inactive rows on hover focus

techniques.name: Hover preview panel
techniques.description: Floating card preview on list hover — project screenshot, shader, or demo UI
assetHints: Project screenshot or live demo frame

techniques.name: Bookshelf carousel
techniques.description: Horizontal book spines or curated objects — one expands on hover
assetHints: Book spine images or CSS spines

techniques.name: Grain atmosphere
techniques.description: Subtle noise on gradients or dark surfaces — tactile premium, not flat digital
stealList: SVG noise or CSS grain overlay

techniques.name: Narrow measure
techniques.description: Content column ~36–42rem centered — margins do the design work
motionHints: Scroll is calm — no parallax required

techniques.name: Dither atmosphere
techniques.description: Bayer dither + smooth glow underneath — field breathes and responds to focus, not static wallpaper.
stealList: 4px Bayer cells over soft gradient depth
Horizon band shifts on digit focus / fill

techniques.name: Monochrome discipline
techniques.description: Black/white/one gray — color only when it means something

techniques.name: Blueprint grid
techniques.description: Visible grid lines and hatch corners — structure IS the brand (Tailwind-style)

techniques.name: Code + live preview
techniques.description: Split panel — code on left, rendered output on right. Product proves the headline.

techniques.name: Meta labels
techniques.description: Tiny labels showing tokens/classes used — self-documenting UI
